annotations.title: Start a new client's claiming analysis

description: For financial advisors (sign in with your myssagent.com account when prompted; an advisor account is not needed yet). Use it when the advisor wants to add a new client or run MySSAgent's analysis for a client who is not on their roster yet. Takes only the client's name, marital status and, for a married client, the spouse's name, and returns one myssagent.com link where the advisor finishes: opening an advisor account if they have none, uploading the client's SSA statement (the birth dates and earnings record come from it), and running the analysis; a pay-per-client account pays for the household there, from its wallet. Nothing runs and nothing is charged in this conversation. Never pass a Social Security number, a birth date or an account number. After the advisor finishes on the page, list_clients and get_client_report return the new client here.

client_name.description: The client's name as the advisor gave it.

spouse_name.description: Married clients only, optional: the spouse's name.
